mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The requested flag is inverted both on the owner and during recursive propagation.

 try:

 except KeyError:

mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Supported mappings return NotImplemented, inverting the operand acceptance contract.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Reject nonmappings and return a new merged Dict for supported operands.

discriminating_observation.description:

left=Dict(a=1)
right=Dict(b=2)
merged=left|right

assert left=={'a':1} and right=={'b':2}
assert merged is not left and merged is not right
assert Dict.__or__(left,object()) is NotImplemented
print('union_dispatch_and_new_result',True)
